capabilities: Add categorized comments anchored to text selections with underlines and closing markers
Reply in threads, sign replies with author tags, and resolve or reopen comments
Review AI rewrites with accept, revise, or reject that restores the original text
Export a skill file teaching AI assistants the marker format and category vocabulary
Browse and jump between comments from a scoped sidebar hub across files, folders, or the vault
extras: Reads and writes only the vault with no network requests or telemetry. Offers a public, versioned API so companion plugins can create and read comments without a hard dependency. Supports importing Obsidian %%comments%% and plain HTML comments, and ships a Pandoc Lua filter to strip markers at export.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to leave anchored, categorized review comments inside a document's text that survive in the file, support reply threads, and can be read by AI assistants or stripped at export.

relations.evidence: With both installed, its findings show in the hub's Findings tab, and a finding can be promoted to an Annoteca comment.
Annoteca MindMap Bridge puts your comments on the Mind map editor plugin's maps

summary: Annotation plugin that adds categorized, threaded inline feedback comments to long-form Markdown, stored as plain HTML markers readable by humans and AI assistants.
